1	---
2	author: 
3	id: F_416
4	internalId: 04b4a3a2-45cc-425c-bc43-6c46a294447c
5	title: use icons on markdown editor toolbar
6	status: ready for implementation
7	owner: 
8	affects:
9	agents:
10	  - design/activity/card__04b4a3a2-45cc-425c-bc43-6c46a294447c.json
11	policy:
12	---
13	
14	we currently have 2 text buttons (rich-text and source) on the markdown editor toolbar. we should replace them with icon buttons, no text, but with tooltip
15	## Current state
16	
17	* `MarkdownSourceModeControls` (`app/src/components/editor/source/markdown_source_mode_controls.tsx`) renders MUI `ToggleButtonGroup` (`aria-label="Markdown view"`, exclusive, small) with two text `ToggleButton`s: `rich-text` → "Rich text", `source` → "Source". No icons, no tooltips.
18	* Rendered in two places, both get the change automatically:
19	  * editor toolbar: `MarkdownEditor` (`app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor.tsx`), first item in toolbar when not plain text, toolbar not hidden, view mode not `diff`.
20	  * compact recovery bar: `MarkdownSourceRecovery` (`app/src/components/editor/source/markdown_source_recovery.tsx`), shown in compact editors on conversion error or source mode.
21	* Sibling toolbar icon controls (`markdown_list_indent_toolbar_controls.tsx`, `markdown_emoji_toolbar_control.tsx`) use pattern: `Tooltip` title + matching `aria-label` + Outlined icon with `fontSize="small"`. Existing `ToggleButton` + `Tooltip` pattern: `markdown_local_text_search_plugin.tsx` ("Match case").
22	* `STYLE_GUIDE.md`: icon-only control needs `Tooltip` and `aria-label`; icons from `@mui/icons-material` Outlined variants.
23	* MUI 9: `ToggleButton` reads group state through React context, so wrapping a `ToggleButton` in `Tooltip` keeps selection and `onChange` working.
24	* `markdown_editor_reliability.real.test.tsx` finds the buttons by accessible name (`getByRole('button', { name: 'Source' | 'Rich text' })`) and checks `aria-pressed`.
25	
26	## Implementation details
27	
28	1. In `markdown_source_mode_controls.tsx`, replace button text with icons:
29	   * `rich-text`: `ArticleOutlined` icon, `aria-label="Rich text"`, wrapped in `Tooltip title="Rich text"`.
30	   * `source`: `CodeOutlined` icon, `aria-label="Source"`, wrapped in `Tooltip title="Source"`.
31	   * Icons `fontSize="small"`, same as sibling toolbar icon buttons.
32	2. Keep `ToggleButtonGroup`, its `aria-label`, `exclusive`, `size="small"`, `value`, and `handleModeChange` unchanged. Mode switch behavior unchanged.
33	3. Accessible names stay "Rich text" / "Source" (via `aria-label`), so existing reliability tests keep working without edits.
34	4. No changes to `markdown_editor.tsx`, `markdown_source_recovery.tsx`, or controller.
35	
36	### Edge cases
37	
38	* Tooltip on selected or disabled button: buttons are never disabled here; no `span` wrapper needed.
39	* Compact recovery bar: same component, shows icons + tooltips too.
40	* `diff` view and plain-text editors: control not rendered, unchanged.
41	
42	### Tests
43	
44	* Add `markdown_source_mode_controls.test.tsx` (next to component): renders with `@mdxeditor/editor` stub; assert buttons named "Rich text" and "Source" have no visible text, show tooltip text on hover, and clicking "Source" calls controller `setMode('source')`.
45	* Existing `markdown_editor_reliability.real.test.tsx` must pass unchanged.
46	
47	## Acceptance criteria
48	
49	* Markdown editor toolbar shows two icon-only toggle buttons for rich text and source; no button text.
50	* Hover or keyboard focus on each button shows tooltip "Rich text" / "Source".
51	* Screen readers announce buttons as "Rich text" / "Source"; selected button has `aria-pressed="true"`.
52	* Clicking a button switches view mode as before; active mode stays visibly selected.
53	* Compact recovery bar shows same icon buttons.
54	* Diff view and plain-text editors unchanged.

entries.content: - **Dialog / popup:** `Dialog`/`Popover` with `PaperProps` → `background.paper`, 1px `divider`, radius 14, big shadow; scrim via `slotProps.backdrop` (blur + tint). Bands separated by hairlines; footer on a `background.default` bar with top hairline; actions right-aligned (outlined Cancel + contained CTA). `autoFocus` first field; submit on `Enter` (`⌘/Ctrl+Enter` in a textarea); close on `Esc`/backdrop — except that a dialog holding unsaved multi-field input may refuse `backdropClick` (return early from `onClose(event, reason)`) so a stray click on the scrim cannot discard typed values; `Esc` and the Cancel button must still close it, and Cancel stays visible and enabled, including while loading.
